messages:
Aisha Patel: Quick sync — we need alignment on embed endpoint launch gating: batching limits, dim support (512/1024/2048), model variants, and response envelope. Customer asks: 512 vs 2048 dims, per-request batch size up to 500, SLA for 99th latency. Who can own tradeoffs?

Sam Cole: From PM side: primary constraint is customer's latency SLA. If we expose 2048 on hosted it will blow cost/SLOs. Proposal: hosted default = 1024, 2048 available only on Dedicated. Need perf numbers from eng. cc @Denis @Mia :eyes:

Denis Park: Technical notes — serving 2048 dims increases KV cache pressure and memory per-request. On our current 16GB configs effective max batch for 1024 is ~200 items; for 2048 it drops to ~80. That doesn't include network/serialize overhead. We can implement smart routing: auto-fallback to Dedicated pool for 2048 requests.

Mia Lopez: Model standpoint — recommend pinning model variants: v2-embed-small (512), v2-embed-large (1024), v2-embed-xxl (2048). Need to run evals on retrieval quality vs dims; some customers prefer 512 for cost, others need 2048 for edge cases. Also suggest response envelope include dims and model id, e.g.:

```json
{"embedding": [...], "dim": 1024, "model": "v2-embed-large", "model_version": "2026-03-10"}
```

Aisha Patel: Example client ask: allow heterogeneous batch (mix 512 & 1024) in a single request to simplify client logic. Thoughts? Also we need to define launch gating: perf numbers, SLA targets, and fallback behavior documented.

Denis Park: Mixing dims in same request kills batching benefits — server has to split and run separate kernels per-dim which reduces throughput and complicates latency SLO accounting. Two options: 1) require uniform-dim per request (simpler, faster), or 2) accept mixed requests but server-side will split into sub-batches (transparent but higher latency and cost). My preference: uniform-dim per-request for launch.

Sam Cole: Action items / owners: 1) eng-platform (Denis) propose default dims + per-GPU batch targets and estimated cost impact; 2) eng-ml (Mia) pin model variants + quality perf numbers; 3) PM (Aisha) draft launch gating doc with SLA thresholds (99p latency, throughput targets, fallback rules). Target: decision sync next Wed. :calendar:

infra-bot: perf-runner: scheduled perf tests started at 1972468045 for denis-perf-runner. Artifacts will be uploaded to the perf bucket and linked in #eng-platform-perf.

Aisha Patel: Thanks all — I'll synthesize notes and share a one-pager. @Sam please confirm SLA thresholds you want included (99p ms target + acceptable fallback latency).
